f.name: Your name
f.thanks: Thanks! We look at new games every week.
f.e_busy: Too many at once. Try later.
seo.desc: Daily games in {lang}: words, numbers, maps and more, in one place.
seo.words_d: Daily word games in English, like Wordle. Free, no sign-up, a new puzzle every day.
claim.intro: It's free, and your game stays on the list either way. Once it's yours, you can write its line, choose its kind and add a logo.
claim.s1: Put this line on your page
claim.s2_p: We open your page once and look for the line. You can take it off after.
claim.joined: It's with your other games now.
claim.key: This is your maker key. This device keeps it. Keep a copy too: it opens your games on any device, and you see it only this once.
claim.other: Can't change the page? Write to {mail}.
claim.used_p: Each link works once. You can still claim a game with a line on its page: open the game here and choose {claim}.
claim.e_nocode: A newer line replaced this one. Get a new line.
claim.e_nometa: We didn't find the line. It must be in the page's HTML, not added by a script. Check it and try again.
claim.e_noopen: Your page didn't open for us. Try again in a minute.
claim.e_moved: This address now goes to another site, so we can't check it. Write to us.
claim.e_busy: Too many tries. Try again in an hour.
claim.e_token: This link no longer works: each link works once. You can still claim with a line on your page.
claim.e_nogame: This game is not on the list now.
maker.nokey: There's no maker key on this device. You get one when you claim a game: open its page here and choose {claim}.
maker.e_key: This key doesn't open anything. Check it and try again.
maker.e_busy: Too many tries. Try again later.
maker.name: Your name, as players see it
maker.line: Its line in {lang}: what you do in the game
maker.e_blocked: Some of these words can't be used here.
maker.e_nogame: This game isn't yours to change.
maker.logo_how: A square PNG, JPEG or WebP picture, at least 256 pixels, at most 150 KB. It shows after we look at it.
maker.logo_wait: Your new logo is waiting for a look.
maker.logo_on: It shows on your game here.
maker.logo_sent: Sent. It shows after we look at it.
maker.e_type: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP picture.
maker.e_big: The picture is over 150 KB. Make it smaller.
maker.e_small: The picture must be at least 256 pixels wide and high.
maker.e_huge: The picture is too big: 4096 pixels at most.
maker.e_bad: We can't read this file as a picture.
maker.note: Your words go live at once, and we look at every change. To change a game's address or language, or to take it off, write to {mail}.
maker.forget: Forget the key on this device
maker.badge_p: Optional. Copy it onto your page if you like.
mail.subject: {game} is on {play}
mail.n: Players sent to it so far: {n}
mail.claim: Claim it to add your logo and see its players by day and country: {link}
mail.reply: Nothing else is needed. To take it off, just reply.
